what: While the 560vh panel stays pinned (share filtered with spring 100·30) — two left vertical progress lines fill at 0~10% and 10~22%, stage 1 (input → result) rises 24px and disappears at 10~15%, and stage 2 settles in from 24px below at 13~20%. At 25~44% the stage 2 result photo grows (to the scale at which three videos fit in one row on screen) and moves to the left column while rising 56px, and the rest (input, arrow, title, progress lines) vanish at 25~33%. Once the result is fully grown (.78~1) a video turns on over it and a new title rises from 20px below, and the center and right videos float up from 40px below at 50~68% and 74~92%. A video plays from the start the moment it has fully risen (.985), and stops and rewinds when scrolled back

options.lift: Distance risen upward when growing (px), default 56
options.min: Applied only from this width (px), default 768 — below it the panel is hidden, so the user stacks their own panel separately
options.[data-fx-part=stick]: Panel stuck to the screen height (required)
options.[data-fx-part=result] > [data-fx-part=zo: Step 2 result cell and the frame for the enlarged photo (key) — inside the frame [data-fx-part=clip] turns on once the video is fully enlarged
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Things that fade away as the result grows (multiple)
options.[data-fx-part=bar] ×2: Inside the left progress line (optional) — height goes 0→100%
options.[data-fx-part=title2] · [data-fx-part=vi: New title · center and right video slots · captions for the three videos (optional) — js measures the placement
